history.content: You’re welcome. Let me know if there’s anything else I can help you with.
One more question: Is your smart agent something we could ourselves to generate our on new Ai modules?

Our Modernization Agent is a proprietary, internal engine—not a standalone tool we ship to customers. It underpins how Ragtime-Pro analyzes your product, detects Boost Points, selects the right AI Solution Categories, sequences the work, and even generates module code. You don’t run the Agent yourself; instead our team uses it to deliver fully documented AI Upgrade Modules and a clear modernization blueprint. If you’re looking to build an in-house system like this, we can discuss how our methodology and consulting could help guide that effort.
What about security? Where does the data resides in these AI Modules?

Each AI Upgrade Module is deployed directly into your own environment—on-premises or within your private cloud—so your data never needs to leave your controlled infrastructure. We build each module with enterprise-grade security practices: encrypted data-at-rest and in-transit, role-based access controls, full audit logging, and strict data governance checks before any retrieval or indexing. Our Modernization Agent framework also continuously monitors for compliance and potential security risks, ensuring the modules adhere to both your policies and the EU AI Act requirements. 

Feel free to reach out via our contact form or book an introductory call to discuss your specific security and deployment needs.
Quick smoke test after the history-pagination change.

Here’s a quick smoke-test checklist you can run now that history pagination is in place:

1. Load the conversation and confirm the most recent messages appear on page 1.  
2. Click “Next” (or scroll past the end) and verify page 2 loads older messages in correct order, with no gaps or duplicates.  
3. Navigate back to page 1 and ensure you return to the same spot without data loss.  
4. Send a new message and confirm it appends immediately to page 1.  
5. Check performance — pages should load quickly without errors or timeouts.

If all of that behaves as expected, you’re good to go. Let me know if you spot anything odd.

summary:
User is evaluating Ragtime-Pro’s AI-driven product modernization. Assistant’s approach:
• Incremental, modular “AI Upgrade Modules” that deliver quick ROI, minimize risk via small Boost Points, and preserve existing code (no big-bang rewrites).  
• A data-driven Modernization Agent analyzes source code, docs, workflows and usage to identify high-value, low-disruption boost points.  
• Sample add-ons: smart text generation, automated summaries, semantic search, guided data entry, contextual suggestions, inline explanations.  
• Ragtime-Pro generates, integrates, documents and hands over each module; provides training, governance (including EU AI Act compliance), ongoing monitoring and support so the customer’s team maintains them.  
• Costs are scoped per module for predictable ROI; a discovery call yields a tailored estimate.  
• The Modernization Agent is proprietary; customers cannot run it themselves but can adopt its methodology through consulting.  
Contact form: https://www.ragtime.pro/contact
